parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Http2
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable `Http2`.

- `open`: enables `Http2`.

- `close`: disables `Http2`.

- `globalConfig`: uses the global configuration.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name that you want to update.

parameters.name: MustHttps
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcibly redirect requests to HTTPS.

parameters.name: TlsMax
parameters.description: The maximum Transport Layer Security (TLS) version.
